note: A closed set (inline one_of:, type-position one_of(...), and a multi-field member table) holds its members alone at the aggregate, one value object down, in a list member, two levels down with a type-position set, three levels down and in a list member there. A value that is no member is refused with the set's own wording on both runtimes, whatever the depth; a bare scalar stands in for a one-field set. The same values are held to the mint audit's answers by spec/rust_host_reference_validate_conformance_spec.rb. The optional slots a value leaves out are echoed absent by Ruby and as null by a Rust record, so this fixture is compared with the null-valued keys dropped from both sides, and nothing else is loosened.
